notes.title: Big Apozomb Update – New Mode, Missions, and Improvements!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129305/83dc866372c322c79772ad7fa1fcfe9ae3d5525a.png
In the past few weeks, we have been working hard on many new features and improvements for Apozomb. The biggest addition is the PvP mode "Supplies," where two teams fight for supplies for their camp. Whoever grabs the crate will be instantly marked for enemies—no easy road to victory!

Besides that, we have improved Wavemode. We added missions between waves, which can be accepted at the radio station in the camp. One of them, for example, puts you in the role of a defender of a broadcast tower against waves of zombies! Another new feature is the ability to upgrade tents in the camp, allowing players to unlock lower equipment prices.

To make the game smoother and more enjoyable, we focused on optimization and performance tuning. On top of that, we are working on a unique soundtrack that will give Apozomb an unforgettable atmosphere.

🔥 Want to be part of it?
Add Apozomb to your Steam wishlist and join our Discord! Every voice and support help us move forward. Thanks, everyone! 🚀
